identity.title: Recreational Marijuana Producer License — Tier II Indoor

scan.summary: This is a recreational marijuana producer license issued by the Oregon Liquor and Cannabis Commission authorizing Evergreen Botanicals, LLC to produce marijuana at its Eugene location. The license is valid for the current term of March 3, 2026 to March 2, 2027, permits up to 10,000 square feet of mature plant canopy in an indoor facility, and carries five conditions that the company must meet to remain authorized.
scan.freshness_note: License is current as of today (2026-09-25). Expiration is in 159 days on March 2, 2027. A renewal application and fee must be received by the Commission no later than 20 days before expiration (by February 10, 2027).

scan.confidence_notes: High confidence on the permit's core elements: it is a valid, current OLCC Recreational Marijuana Producer License issued March 3, 2026, expiring March 2, 2027. The five conditions are clear and directly stated. The renewal deadline of February 10, 2027 is calculated from the explicit 20-day requirement. Condition 4 on video surveillance was verified against current OAR 845-025-1450 rules; the rules have been updated recently to require off-site real-time backup, and the 90-day retention period in the license matches current regulations. I found no gaps in the permit itself—permits are agency documents and do not contain gaps to fix. The company must simply meet the stated conditions and renew in time. I did not search for general information about Oregon cannabis licensing procedures beyond what was necessary to verify the specific regulatory citations.
